reproduction.method: Block-L2 proximal ISTA versus scalar-L1 ISTA on row-orthonormal measurements
reproduction.description: Reconstructs genuinely Gaussian and uniform group-sparse signals with actual block shrinkage, objective histories and proximal optimality residuals.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
80 coefficients, 56 observations, 10 groups of size 8 and two active groups replace 4096/1024/64 groups/eight active groups.
Explicit monotone ISTA (≤450 updates) replaces SpaRSA; λ=0.12 max block norm(Aᵀy), shared across the two different penalties.
No block-L∞ fit or post-selection debiasing; plots are explicitly the penalized, biased estimates. Gaussian noise retains standard deviation 0.02.
